name: TIME ERC-2771 Multicall sender spoof
summary: TIME combined a trusted-forwarder ERC-2771 context with self-delegatecall Multicall. A forwarded multicall could append an attacker-chosen address to an inner call, making burn() treat the TIME/WETH pair as the sender; the attacker burned the pair's TIME reserve, synchronized the pool, and drained WETH at the distorted price.
notes: The factory CREATE2-deployed and initialized the immutable EIP-1167 clone in one transaction, fixing both its implementation and trusted-forwarder set. The forwarder mapping has no post-initialization setter.

The receipt records 5 WETH entering the TIME/WETH pair and 94.513462587046838316 WETH leaving it, for exact net victim depletion of 89.513462587046838316 WETH. DefiLlama's nearest prior ETH observation values it at $199,339.32. The commonly reported 84.59 ETH is attacker proceeds after the approximately 5 ETH transaction-builder payment. The burned TIME reserve is the mechanism of the same drain and is not valued again.
